snippet.title: Solitaire Longplay (Vircon32) [60FPS]
snippet.description:
This is a full gameplay of the game Solitaire, for Vircon32 console. As always, this game and the console itself are free and open source! You can get them at the website (see link below). This is based on the hard setting: 3 cards are drawn at a time.

🌏 Vircon32 website: https://www.vircon32.com
🐦 Twitter account: https://twitter.com/vircon32
